outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot showing averages.
Panel B is a set of phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot.
The bar chart in panel C (bottom) displays mean ± SEM bars with individual data points (circle, square, triangle markers) overlaid for each of the three replicates per group.
The bar chart in panel D (bottom) displays mean ± SD bars with individual data points overlaid for each of the three replicates per group.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized expression values; heatmaps are exempt from the individual data points requirement.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot showing averages.
Both bar charts in panel G show mean ± SEM with individual data points (triangle/square/circle markers) overlaid for each of the three replicates per gene/condition.
Panel H is a set of immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot showing averaged data.
